exposure: Maternal thyroid function during the first half of pregnancy (TSH, fT4, UIC)
Thyroid status (euthyroid, hypothyroxinaemia, hypothyroidism, hyperthyroxinaemia, hyperthyroidism)
cohort: The study included 2170 pregnant women and their children from four Spanish areas.
finding: High maternal fT4 levels during the first half of pregnancy were associated with lower birthweight and an increased risk of small for gestational age (SGA) newborns.
